n-m-e2-s2-02.title: Singalithemba yini ithebula lokuphindaphinda umthetho uMina awuthole?
n-m-e2-s2-02.topic: Ithebula lokuphindaphinda: ukuthola imithetho ethebuleni lokuphindaphinda
n-m-e2-s2-02.goal: Qonda ukuthi umthetho awulunga njalo ngoba nje izibonelo ezimbalwa ziyahambisana, bese wenza izibalo zakho lapho umphumela wethebula lenombolo engaphindwayo uyi-even, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani umphumela uyi-even.
n-m-e2-s2-02.material: UMina wayebheka ithebula lokuphindaphinda futhi wathi lokhu. "Amatafula ama-3, ama-5, ama-7 nama-9 amatafula angaphindwayo. Imiphumela yonke iyi-odd, njengo-3×3=9, 3×5=15, 5×7=35, 7×9=63. Ngakho imiphumela yamatafula angaphindwayo njalo iyi-odd."
n-m-e2-s2-02.thinking.0: Ukwahlulela ukuthi umthetho uyiqiniso njalo yini nanxa izibonelo eziningana ziyahambisana
n-m-e2-s2-02.thinking.2: Ukuthola isimo sokuthi umphumela ube yi-even
n-m-e2-s2-02.prereq.0: Amatafula okuphindaphinda kusukela kuma-2 kuya kuma-9
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izibalo ezibonisa ukuthi isitatimende sikaMina asilungile.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kusibalo ngasinye, bala umphumela futhi ubhale ukuthi uyi-even noma i-odd.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.hint.1: UMina wathi 'njalo i-odd', ngakho cabanga ukuthi yisiphi isibalo esinikeza umphumela ophikisana nalesi sitatimende.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.a: Leli yithebula lama-5 futhi umphumela ungu-30, oyi-even. Bheka ukuthi ithebula lenombolo engaphindwayo lingabe linikeza umphumela ongeyona i-odd yini.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.b: Umphumela uyi-odd, ngakho uvumelana nesitatimende sikaMina. Noma kunezibonelo eziningi ezihambisanayo, lokho akusho ukuthi isitatimende sihlala siyiqiniso.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.c: Umphumela wokuphindaphinda awuphindwa, ngakho uyavumelana nesitatimende sikaMina. Ukuqoqa izibonelo eziningi ezifanayo kwehlukile ekuthatheni isibonelo esingalungile.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu ithebula lika-3 futhi umphumela ungu-24, ophindwayo. Bheka ukuthi ithebula elingaphindwayo lingalinikeza yini umphumela ongaphindwayo.
n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s1.explain: 5×6=30 no-3×8=24 yizibonelo lapho ithebula elingaphindwayo linikeza khona umphumela ophindwayo. n-m-e2-s2-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza izinkulumo ezintathu ezihlukene etafuleni lokuphindaphinda lapho isitatimende sikaMina singelona iqiniso. Phindaphinda ithebula elingaphindwayo x (elilodwa kokungu-3, 5, 7, 9) ngenombolo y (kusukela ku-2 kuya ku-9) ukuze umphumela uphindwe.

n-m-e2-s2-05.title: Singakwethemba kangakanani lokho esikutholile ethebuleni ezimbili?
n-m-e2-s2-05.topic: Amathebula namagrafu: yini amathebula amabili angasitshela yona
n-m-e2-s2-05.goal: Qonda ukuthi amathebula amabili ahlola abantu abafanayo ngezindlela ezimbili asitshela kuphela inani ngalinye ngokwehlukana futhi asikutsheli inani labantu abakhethe zombili izinto, bese uhlunga ukuthi yiliphi idatha elengeziwe elidingekayo ukuze kutholakale lokho.
n-m-e2-s2-05.material:
Abafundi abangu-20 baseKilasini 1, Banga 2 bahlolwe ngezinto ezimbili. Umuntu ngamunye ukhethe isithelo esisodwa nombala owodwa kuphela. Wonke umuntu uphendule zonke izinhlolo.
Isithelo asithandayo: i-apula 9, i-tangerine 6, amagilebhisi 5
Umbala awuthandayo: obomvu 8, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 7, ophuzi 5
U-Jia ubheka amathebula amabili futhi ufuna ukuthola ukuthi bangaki abafundi abathanda kokubili obomvu ne-apula.
